In-browser text-to-speech for the Jarvis demo (jarvis.html, tts-worker.js).
kokoro.web.js          kokoro-js 1.2.1 (Apache-2.0), bundles Transformers.js 3.5.1 (Apache-2.0)
ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs/.wasm   ONNX Runtime Web from @huggingface/transformers@3.5.1/dist (MIT)
The Kokoro-82M model (Apache-2.0) and the bm_daniel voice are downloaded by the visitor's browser
from huggingface.co/onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX on first use, not served from this site.
